title_en: Upgrade Your Gaming Chair With Secretlab’s New Pokémon Pixel Art Skins Featuring Charizard, Blastoise, and Venusaur
body_en:
Secretlab, maker of our favorite gaming chair , the Titan Evo, has launched a new Pokémon-Themed upgrade kit for its chairs. The new looks come in the form of Secretlab Skins, a kind of slip-cover for the Titan Evo line of chairs that let you customize their look without having to buy an entirely new chair.
The new Pokémon Pixel Art Collection features the iconic final evolutions of the original three starter Pokémon: Charizard, Blastoise, and Venusaur, each rendered in a pixel-art style.
These new covers join Secretlab's broader Pokémon collection, which launched earlier this year with chairs (not Skins) featuring Pikachu, Eevee, and Gengar. There's also a broader collection of Skins available, ranging from simple colorswaps to other themed options, including Dragonball Z, Star Wars, One Piece, and Cyberpunk 2077.
The Pokémon Pixel Art Collection of Skins is available now for $99 each.
Bo Moore is IGN's Senior Manager of Tech. You can find him online @usebomswisely.
